tagline: Your health records, in simple language

demo.dataBanner: Demo: sample data. Changes may reset.
demo.bothBanner: Demo: sample data and AI answers. May reset.

records.title: Records
records.subtitle: Your prescriptions and lab reports, all in one place.
records.empty: No records yet. Upload a document to get started.

showDoctor.title: Show the doctor
showDoctor.subtitle: A print-ready summary of your health records.
showDoctor.disclaimer: Generated from your confirmed records. This is not a diagnostic tool; please discuss with a doctor.
showDoctor.notIncluded: {{count}} more uploaded and not yet checked, so not included here.
showDoctor.checkinsCount: {{logged}} of {{total}} days. Blank days are not counted.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: No records yet. Upload a prescription or lab report to get started.
dashboard.askDesc: Ask questions about your health records
dashboard.nextReviewBody: Check that the values were read correctly. It takes about a minute.
dashboard.nextCheckinBody: Log sleep, water and how you feel. Every field is optional.
dashboard.nextUploadBody: Take a photo of a prescription or lab report.
dashboard.nextDoneBody: Today's check-in is done. Before your next visit, open the doctor page.
dashboard.tourStep1: 1. See a value on the paper
dashboard.tourStep1Body: Open Records, pick Needs review, and tap a value. It lights up on the paper.
dashboard.tourStep2: 2. Watch Muse read a paper live
dashboard.tourStep2Body: In Records, tap Sample blood test. It is read on this device, then by Muse.
dashboard.tourStep3Body: Answers come only from your records and show their sources.
dashboard.tourStep4Body: A print-ready page with values as written and the lab's own ranges.
dashboard.switchDemoBody: You're using sample data. Switch to a different recovering or healthy story.
dashboard.sleepGaps: No check-in on {{count}} of these days, so they stay empty.
dashboard.noResultBody: Your first lab value will show here, on a bar like this one.
dashboard.estimatesNote: Rough figures from what you logged. Not measured by a device, and not a medical result.

readings.title: Readings you entered
readings.empty: Have a blood pressure cuff, oximeter, thermometer or scale at home? Add its numbers here, to keep them and show your doctor.
readings.note: You typed these in from your own device. Not measured by MediSathi, and it doesn't judge them. Ask your doctor what they mean for you.
readings.sheetBody: Copy the numbers from your device for today. Fill in only what you have. If you save one again today, it replaces the old one.
readings.nothingEntered: Type at least one number first.
readings.checkNumber: Check this number. It doesn't look like something the device would show.
readings.urgent: Feeling very unwell? Call 999 or go to the nearest hospital.
readings.reportNote: Typed in by the person from their own device. Not checked by MediSathi.

documents.title: Documents
documents.ocrReady: Text read. Check it, then press Upload.
documents.aiFailed: Could not read this document. You can try again.
documents.help: Photo (JPG or PNG) or PDF, up to 4 MB and 5 pages. Your phone reads the text first, then the file is sent to Meta's AI (Muse Spark) to read it too.
documents.deleteConfirmDesc: Delete this document and its extracted values? This can't be undone.
documents.pick: Take a photo or choose a file
documents.ocrLabel: Text read from the paper (fix it if needed)
documents.sampleTitle: No paper with you? Try a sample
documents.uploadFailed: Upload didn't finish. Check your connection and try again.
documents.unsupported: Use a JPG or PNG photo, or a PDF.
documents.stageOcr: Reading the paper on this device…
documents.stageAi: Muse is reading the paper. This takes about 30 seconds…
documents.limits: Photo (JPG or PNG) or PDF, up to 4 MB and 5 pages.
documents.privacy: Your phone reads the text first. Then the file is sent to Meta's AI (Muse Spark) to read it too.
documents.readingNote: Nothing is saved until you have checked it.
documents.tooManyPages: This PDF has more than 5 pages.

review.title: Check this paper
review.noExtraction: No values were found in this document.
review.saveFailed: Your edits weren't saved. Try again.
review.subtitle: Compare each value with the paper. Fix anything that's wrong, then mark it checked.
review.confirmHint: Check every value to save this record.
review.loadFailed: This document couldn't be opened. Go back to Records and try again.
review.tapHint: Tap any value to see it on the paper.
review.notOnPaper: couldn't find this on the paper. Please look for it yourself.
review.dateAmbiguous: This could mean {{date}} or {{other}}. Please check which is right.
review.dateUnclear: Please check this date against the paper.
review.dateMissing: No date was found. Add it if the paper has one, or mark it checked to save it undated.
review.onlyAi: Only the AI could read this
review.onlyPhone: Only your phone could read this
review.keepWritten: Change it if it's wrong. We keep the words as written and never swap them for another medicine name.

checkin.title: Daily check-in
checkin.optionalNote: Every field is optional. Takes under a minute.
checkin.symptomStrokeSigns: Stroke signs (face droops, arm weak, slurred speech)
checkin.urgentGroupHint: If you have any of these now, get help right away.
checkin.saveFailed: Check-in wasn't saved. Check your connection and try again.
checkin.urgentQuestion: Do you have any of these right now?
checkin.urgentHelp: If yes, tap it. We'll show you how to get help.
checkin.feelHelp: Choose the one that feels closest.
checkin.mildDesc: I notice it, but I can manage
checkin.energyQuestion: How much energy do you have?

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.explainFailed: Couldn't explain this record. Try again.
timeline.explainNote: From AI. It may be wrong. This is not medical advice.

summary.title: Health summary
summary.noRecords: There are no confirmed records to summarize yet. Add a document first.
summary.urgentQuestion: On {{dates}} I noted: {{symptoms}}. What should I do about this?
summary.sourceGone: A paper behind this was deleted.

ask.title: Ask about your records
ask.notFound: I couldn't find this in your records.
ask.modelUnavailable: The AI isn't available right now, so there's no answer from your records. Try again later.
ask.label: Your question
ask.examples: For example: Is my hemoglobin normal?
ask.voiceNotSupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
ask.introShort: Answers come from your saved papers. Questions about a medicine use its official label.
ask.privacy: Your question and those records are sent to Meta's AI (Muse Spark). This is not medical advice.
ask.medicineNote: General information from a U.S. label, not advice about you. Medicines sold in Bangladesh may differ. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before you start, stop or change a medicine.
ask.medicineNotFound: I couldn't find an official label for {{name}}. Local brand names often aren't listed. Your doctor or pharmacist can tell you what it is.
ask.medicineUnavailable: I couldn't reach the official medicine source just now. Please try again in a moment.

report.title: Doctor report
report.disclaimer: Generated from your confirmed records. This is not a diagnostic tool; please discuss with a doctor.

auth.error: Wrong email or password. Please try again.
auth.signUpHint: Sign up to save your own health records.
auth.demoExplain: Try the demo — you get your own private sample account.
auth.chooseProfileHint: 3 recovering, 2 staying healthy. Synthetic data only.
auth.privacy: Your phone reads each paper first, then it is sent to Meta's AI (Muse Spark) to read too. Records are not end-to-end encrypted.

common.loadFailed: This couldn't load. Your records are safe. Check your connection and try again.
common.stillWorking: Still working. This can take about 30 seconds.

footer.disclaimer: MediSathi explains your records in simple language. It is not a diagnostic tool and never replaces a doctor.

redflag.title: This may need urgent care
redflag.bn: এটি জরুরি চিকিৎসার প্রয়োজন হতে পারে। বাংলাদেশে ৯৯৯ নম্বরে কল করুন অথবা নিকটতম হাসপাতালে যান।
redflag.en: This may need urgent care. In Bangladesh call 999 or go to the nearest hospital.

chart.missingDays: No check-in on {{count}} of the last 30 days. Those days are left blank, not counted as zero.

landing.headline: Your doctor's paper, in words you can read.
landing.sub: MediSathi reads prescriptions and lab reports, checks every number against the paper with you, and explains them in simple Bangla or English. It never diagnoses or prescribes.
landing.note: Opens Rahima's sample records. Made-up data, no sign-up.
landing.error: The demo didn't start. Please try again.
landing.calloutBody: Below the range printed on this paper. Worth asking your doctor about.
landing.step1Body: Your phone reads the paper on the device. It is also sent to Meta's AI, Muse Spark, which reads it too. The code compares the two.
landing.step2Body: Tap a value and it lights up on the paper. Nothing is saved until you've looked.
landing.step3Body: Ask questions answered from your own records, with sources, then print a page for your doctor.
landing.noteShared: Opens sample records. Made-up data, no sign-up.
